commentaries.author: Parimelazhagar
commentaries.text: Be free of fault in your mind: that much alone is righteousness. The fault is thinking evil. Words and outward show aren’t righteousness but noise, done so that others will notice. If the mind is stained, what is done by speech and body brings nothing.
